verdict.rationale: Clara documents creating virtual cards that are active immediately, with per-card spend limits and periodicity, lock/unlock/delete, and auto-deletion. That lets a finance lead issue a separate card per subscription or procurement need, which limits exposure if one card is compromised. However, restrictions are documented only at the merchant-category level (MCC, time, day-of-week); nothing shows binding a card to one specific vendor. Missing for 10: merchant-locked (single-vendor) card binding, SaaS/procurement-specific card workflows, independent or hands-on corroboration.
